fields.value: Senior Data Expert – Data Analyst & Data Modeler

Senior Data Expert with 8+ years of experience in Data Analysis, Data Modeling, and large-scale data transformation within financial and enterprise data environments. Strong expertise in Conceptual, Logical, and Physical Data Modeling, SQL-based data analysis, reconciliation logic, and end-to-end data flows. Proven ability to elicit and translate complex business requirements into governed data models, metadata artifacts, and scalable analytics solutions. Extensive experience working in Agile delivery teams, acting as a bridge between business stakeholders and IT, and ensuring clarity, traceability, and alignment across the SDLC. Hands-on experience with GCP BigQuery, cloud data platforms, and modern data governance practices.
Senior Software Engineer / Senior Data Analyst
Supported large-scale financial data transformation programs across enterprise finance systems.
Worked within Agile, cross-functional teams to design and deliver governed, high-quality data solutions.
Led business, functional, and non-functional requirement elicitation with finance stakeholders.
Translated business requirements into conceptual, logical, and physical data models aligned with governance standards.
Designed reconciliation-ready data structures to support financial reporting and controls.
Performed metadata analysis, including entity definitions, attribute naming, data types, lengths, and lineage.
Produced and owned data modeling artifacts, mapping documents, and analysis deliverables for development teams.
Acted as a bridge between Business, Finance, and IT, ensuring requirement clarity throughout the SDLC.
Supported end-to-end data journey mapping, from source systems through transformation to consumption layers.
Used SQL and BigQuery extensively for data analysis, validation, and reconciliation checks.
Ensured traceability and consistency of data and metadata across environments.
Keolis Hyderabad Mass Rapid Transit System Ltd
Gathered and analyzed business and technical requirements for enterprise reporting and analytics.
Designed logical and physical data models to support operational and management reporting.
Created source-to-target mappings, transformation rules, and business logic documentation.
Performed data gap analysis and impact assessments across multiple source systems.
Built and maintained analytics-ready data marts for reporting and reconciliation.
Conducted time-series and trend analysis on transactional datasets.
Developed KPI definitions and ensured alignment between business metrics and underlying data models.
Worked closely with stakeholders to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and usability.
Analyzed high-volume transactional datasets including trips, demand, and fare data.
Created analytical data models to support business reporting and forecasting.
Used SQL for data analysis, validation, and reconciliation.
Developed KPI frameworks and reporting structures aligned with business objectives.
Translated functional requirements into scalable analytical datasets.
